title: LIT, 1m protected-swing stop when the sweep-extreme stop is wider than 30 pts (else skip)
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: upsizing and fewer wide stops - do tighter stops or more contracts pay on LIT?
verdict: Keeps 2.8 trades a week, but at equal risk H2 is below the live stop. 2026 H1 (pick) n=76 2.97/wk win 18.4% PF 4.3 net +81,401 ($13,355/mo) DD -8,418 median stop 15.25 pts, 23.0 micros, $780 at risk; eval 2wk 46.9/32.8 1mo 50.0/35.9 pass rate 58.2% median 4.0; 2026 H2 (check) n=38 2.44/wk win 15.8% PF 1.77 net +10,812 ($2,911/mo) DD -8,379 median stop 17.75 pts, 21.0 micros, $781 at risk; eval 2wk 39.7/41.0 1mo 43.6/52.6 pass rate 45.3% median 5.0; 2021-25 reference only n=436 2.03/wk win 9.2% PF 0.97 net -5,216 ($-102/mo) DD -33,222 median stop 20.0 pts, 19.0 micros, $780 at risk; eval 2wk 12.9/42.9 1mo 16.3/73.9 pass rate 17.2% median 5.0
notes: tools/lit_tightstop.py (wraps engine/lit.py; stop_mode ext + LIT size == run lit_live trade for trade). Same LIT signals and fills; the stop, entry limit or size changes. MFFU $1,000 soft daily loss modelled; NQ minis at $4.50 a round trip.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
